name: Interlocking: radio of the accepting RBC lost
description: Like the handover run, without the freight train ahead, but the radio of RBC 2 is lost at 200 s for 300 s. The onboard cannot open its session with RBC 2, which does not give RBC 1 any route beyond the border: the train stops before the border and continues when the radio of RBC 2 is back.
